一伙武装人员租用了一辆汽车，扣留司机，
征用该车辆，并在一名商人之子离开学校时
将其绑架。

（印：由登记处索引 1940年9月28日）

page_data.en:
At 3.50p.m. 26/9/40, a telephone call was
received at this station from the McTyeire School,
11 Edinburgh Road, reporting that a pupil of the
Primary Section of the school, 15-A Edinburgh Road,
had been kidnapped by a gang of armed men as he
was leaving the school.

A party under Officer i/c B.W. turned out,
and on arrival, it was learned that the kidnappers
had already made good their escape with the victim.

Miss C. Chang (          ), a teacher of the
school, was able to give the following information:-

At about 3.45p.m. 26/9/40, she stood at the
main gates as her pupils went home from school.
She saw one of them named Sung Tsi Tsang (沈齐苍),
age about 10 years, cross the roadway, and prepare
to get into a motor car which was parked at the
roadside. As he did so, three Chinese persons,
all armed, grabbed hold of him, and put him into
a black saloon motor car, bearing the licence plate
17890.

The armed men also took away the car keys from
the chauffeur of the motor car which the pupil had
attempted to enter, then got into their own car,
and drove off north along Edinburgh Road.

All stations were at once circulated to keep
a lookout for motor car 17890.

The motor car standing at the roadside was found
to have the licence number 11084. The chauffeur
could not be located.

At 4.20p.m. 26/9/40, West Hongkew Station
page_data.zh:
1940年9月26日下午3:50，本分局接到位于
爱丁堡路11号的中西女中（McTyeire School）打来的电话，
报告称该校小学部的一名学生，住址为爱丁堡路15-A号，
在离校时被一伙武装人员绑架。

由B区负责警官率领的一队警员随即出动，
抵达现场后获悉，绑匪已携受害者成功逃脱。

该校教师C. Chang小姐（          ）提供了以下信息：

1940年9月26日下午3:45左右，当学生们放学回家时，
她站在校门口。她看到其中一名名叫沈齐苍的学生，
年龄约10岁，穿过马路，准备进入一辆停在路边的
汽车。就在他这样做的时候，三名持械的中国男子
抓住他，将他塞进一辆黑色轿车，车牌号为17890。

这些武装人员还从该学生试图进入的那辆汽车的
司机手中拿走了车钥匙，然后进入他们自己的汽车，
沿爱丁堡路向北驶离。

所有分局立即收到通缉令，要求留意车牌号为17890的汽车。

经查，停在路边的那辆汽车车牌号为11084。未能找到该司机。

1940年9月26日下午4:20，西虹口分局

page_data.en:
2185/40.

1/3.

notified this station that at 4.15p.m. 26/9/40, Sgt.
Parsons of the S.V.C. on duty at the Blockhouse at
Honan Road, had stopped motor car licence No. 17890,
as it was leaving the Settlement via North Honan Road,
and arrested the chauffeur who was the only occupant.
The car, together with the chauffeur Zee Kwang
Zung (徐廣生), permit No. 19151, was brought to
the station. However, this was proved not to be
the car and chauffeur used by the kidnappers. Motor
car 17890 and the chauffeur were therefore allowed to
go at 6p.m. 26/9/40. Circulation cancelled.
// At 5.30p.m. 26/9/40, Gordon Road Station reported
// to this station that at 4p.m. 26/9/40, a hire car
chauffeur had reported to Pootoo Road Station that his
vehicle, licence No. 17960, had been used by armed
kidnappers. Enquiries had revealed that the kidnap-
pers had operated in Bubbling Well District, and the
car and chauffeur were accordingly sent to this
station.
Tseu Liang Tsung (周良箴). Chauffeur, permit
No. 16069, employed by the Dah Kang (大康) Garage,
487 Sinza Road and driver of hire car licence No.
17960 gave the following story:-
At 3p.m. 26/9/40, two Chinese persons came to
page_data.zh:
2185/40.

1/3.

通知本分局，1940年9月26日下午4:15，在河南路碉堡
执勤的上海志愿军（S.V.C.）帕森斯（Parsons）中士，
拦下了正经由河南北路离开租界的牌照号为17890的汽车，
并逮捕了车上唯一的 occupants（乘员）——司机。
该车连同司机徐廣生，执照号19151，被带至分局。
然而，经证实这并非绑匪使用的车辆和司机。因此，
车牌号17890的汽车及司机于1940年9月26日下午6:00
被放行。通缉令撤销。
// 1940年9月26日下午5:30，戈登路分局向
// 本分局报告，1940年9月26日下午4:00，一名租车司机
// 向普陀路分局报告，其车辆（牌照号17960）被武装
// 绑匪使用。经查，绑匪在静安寺地区作案，因此
// 将该车辆及司机送至本分局。
周良箴。司机，执照号
16069，受雇于新闸路487号大康汽车行，驾驶牌照号为
17960的租赁汽车，陈述如下：
1940年9月26日下午3:00，两名中国人来到

page_data.en:
2185/40..
1/4.

the garage, and ordered a car. They paid $3.00
hire fee, and asked to be sent to Zau Ka Doo (曹
家渡 Village.
The chauffeur was detailed to attend, using
motor car 17960.
When the car arrived at Jessfield Road near
Robison Road, the chauffeur was ordered to stop, and
a third person got into the car. The third person
then ordered the chauffeur to drive along Jessfield
Road, and when on the stretch of road at the rear
of Jessfield Park, the chauffeur was again ordered
to stop. The third person then produced a pistol,
and ordered the chauffeur to get out. At this time,
two more persons appeared on the scene. They came
out of a nearby lane, took hold of the chauffeur,
and led him back into the lane.
About half an hour later, the two men allowed
the chauffeur to go. He was given $10.00 and told
that if he went to Robison Road near Kiaochow Road,
he would find his car.
The chauffeur went to the location given, found
his car, and at once reported to the Police.
Motor car licence No. 17960 was examined for
finger prints. None were found.
page_data.zh:
2185/40..
1/4.

车行，叫了一辆车。他们支付了3.00元租车费，
并要求送往曹家渡村。
指派该司机驾驶17960号汽车前往服务。
当汽车行驶至兆丰公园路（Jessfield Road）靠近罗别根路（Robison Road）处时，
司机被命令停车，随后第三人上了车。第三人随即命令司机
沿兆丰公园路行驶，当行至兆丰公园后方路段时，
司机再次被命令停车。第三人随后掏出手枪，
命令司机下车。此时，又有两人出现在现场。他们
从附近的一条弄堂出来，抓住司机，将他带回弄堂内。
约半小时后，这两人放走了司机。他们给了司机10.00元，
并告诉他，如果去胶州路附近的罗别根路，
就能找到他的车。
司机前往指定地点，找到了他的车，并立即向警方报案。
对牌照号为17960的汽车进行了指纹检查。未发现指纹。

page_data.en:
2185/40.

1/5.

The bona fides of the chauffeur Tseu Liang
Tsung were found to be in order, and on instructions
of Sen. Det. i/c., he was allowed to go with his car
at 7.30p.m. 26/9/40.

The owner of motor car 11084 is Mr. Sung Cheu
Zu (沈九如), manager of the Doong Sung (同成)
Silk Factory, Ferry Road, and living at 1285/53
Avenue Joffre.

It was learned that Mr. Sung Cheu Zu was away
from Shanghai, but his representative, together with
the chauffeur of Mr. Sung's car, came to this station.

Tsang Loo Liang (張魯良), chauffeur, permit
No. 7864, employed by Mr. Sung Cheu Zu, said:-

At the time of the kidnapping he was sitting
in his car, waiting for the child to come out of
school. As the child came out of school and
approached the car, two or three persons came up,
took away the child, and took away the motor car keys.
He saw the men get into a motor car, licence number
unknown, and drive away north along Edinburgh Road.
He then ran into the school, telephoned the Police,
and after this, called a ricksha and went straight to
his master's home to tell the family of what had
occurred.
page_data.zh:
2185/40.

1/5.

经查，司机周良箴的身份真实可信，根据高级侦探主管的指示，
他于1940年9月26日晚上7:30获准驾车离开。

牌照号11084汽车的车主是沈九如先生，同成丝厂经理，
该厂位于斐伦路，其住所位于霞飞路1285/53号。

获悉沈九如先生不在上海，但其代表连同沈先生的汽车司机
来到了本分局。

张鲁良，司机，执照号
7864，受雇于沈九如先生，陈述如下：

绑架发生时，他正坐在车里，等待孩子从学校出来。
当孩子走出学校并走近汽车时，两三个人冲上来，
带走了孩子，并拿走了汽车钥匙。
他看到这些人进入一辆汽车，车牌号不详，
沿爱丁堡路向北驶离。
随后他跑进学校，打电话报警，
之后叫了一辆黄包车，直接去主人家告知家人发生的事。
